recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-19698 unless a future Pharmacy or methodology decision reopens the broader receiver target set.
issue_request: FHIR-19698 is a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, asking implementers to review whether MedicationDispense.receiver should support PractitionerRole. Its final resolution says PractitionerRole will be added to MedicationDispense.receiver.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites merge commit d338b629407370eccfc6dcaf5bb04304123a677a as the applied change. That merge brought in implementation commit 54d7ab22de0725d3f012b13b105e4aa23345c5db, which changed the then-authoritative source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-spreadsheet.xml receiver type from Reference(Patient|Practitioner | RelatedPerson | Location) to include PractitionerRole. The current StructureDefinition source carries that target forward.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, so source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml is current build-scope source. An earlier same-element issue, FHIR-19701, declined adding PractitionerRole in November 2018, but FHIR-19698 is the later final Published decision after additional implementer discussion. Later receiver-family audit/source decisions add or preserve other targets such as RelatedPerson, Location, and Organization without removing PractitionerRole. Confluence and Zulip searches found broader Practitioner/PractitionerRole methodology discussion but no later community evidence that reverses the Pharmacy decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active MedicationDispense StructureDefinition already lists PractitionerRole as a targetProfile for MedicationDispense.receiver, satisfying FHIR-19698.
